name: example
description: TEMPLATE, not a runnable target. Copy this file to <your-target>.json, replace every <ANGLE-BRACKET> value, then run: .\gputrace-capture.ps1 -Profile <your-target> -DryRun. The placeholders are left in on purpose - the capture stops on the first one and names it, instead of failing later on a path you never typed. 'env' is optional and normally left empty; fill it in only to force one of your application's diagnostic switches off, for example { "YOUR_DUMP_SWITCH": "0" }, so a trace sees the shaders as they normally compile.
appTimeoutArgs: <YOUR-LIFETIME-FLAG, e.g. --timeout {seconds} - delete this line if your application takes none>
